item.title: Veer 1.0.2
item.description:
Veer 1.0.2 测试版 · Test build

  • “X 走 Y”这类分流修改即时生效，不再重载整个配置，其他连接不受影响。 / Routing changes like “X through Y” apply instantly without reloading the config or cutting other connections.
  • AI 不再把你没有点名的服务放进专为其他服务设置的策略组；只发一个域名时，先说明它现在怎么走再给方案。 / The AI no longer puts unnamed services into groups made for another service; a bare domain gets an explanation and options first.
  • 工具栏去掉出站模式切换；Agent 页的建议卡片不再挤乱窗口。 / The mode switch left the toolbar; suggestion cards no longer push the Agent page out of the window.
  • 请求页补上不到一秒的连接；配置校验不再重复下载 GEO 数据。 / The Requests page lists sub-second connections; config checks reuse downloaded GEO data.
